```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
snapshot_urls <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)

snapshot_years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)

fetch_snapshot <- function(address, snapshot_year) {
  page <- request(address) |>
    req_timeout(120) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3, retry_on_failure = TRUE) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_html()

  chart <- page |>
    html_element("table") |>
    html_table() |>
    select(`Rank & Title`, `IMDb Rating`)

  vote_tooltips <- page |>
    html_elements("td.ratingColumn strong") |>
    html_attr("title")

  if (length(vote_tooltips) != nrow(chart)) {
    stop("The number of rating tooltips does not match the number of chart rows.")
  }

  chart |>
    mutate(
      snap_year = snapshot_year,
      rank = parse_integer(str_extract(`Rank & Title`, "^\\s*\\d+")),
      title = `Rank & Title` |>
        str_remove("^\\s*\\d+\\.\\s*") |>
        str_remove("\\s*\\(\\d{4}\\)\\s*$") |>
        str_squish(),
      year = parse_integer(str_extract(`Rank & Title`, "\\d{4}(?=\\)\\s*$)")),
      rating = parse_number(as.character(`IMDb Rating`)),
      number = parse_number(str_extract(vote_tooltips, "[0-9,]+(?= votes)"))
    ) |>
    select(snap_year, rank, title, year, rating, number)
}

imdb_snapshots <- map2_dfr(snapshot_urls, snapshot_years, fetch_snapshot)
```

```{r}
rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, year, snap_year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = snap_year,
    values_from = rank,
    names_prefix = "rank_"
  ) |>
  drop_na(rank_2015, rank_2022) |>
  mutate(
    release_decade = year %/% 10 * 10,
    rank_change = rank_2022 - rank_2015
  )

rank_changes |>
  arrange(desc(abs(rank_change))) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r}
rank_changes |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarize(average_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(release_decade)
```

```{r}
film_appearances <- imdb_snapshots |>
  distinct(title, snap_year) |>
  count(title, name = "snapshot_count")

film_appearances |>
  count(snapshot_count, name = "film_count") |>
  arrange(snapshot_count)
```

```{r}
rank_changes |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarize(average_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      average_rank_change > 0 ~ "Rank rose",
      average_rank_change < 0 ~ "Rank fell",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    ),
    release_decade = factor(release_decade, levels = sort(unique(release_decade)))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = average_rank_change, y = release_decade, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Rank rose" = "#D55E00",
      "Rank fell" = "#0072B2",
      "No change" = "#999999"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average IMDb Rank Change by Release Decade",
    subtitle = "Comparing the 2015 and 2022 snapshots",
    x = "Average rank change (2022 minus 2015)",
    y = "Release decade",
    fill = "Rank direction",
    caption = paste0(
      "Sample: ", nrow(rank_changes),
      " films appear in both the 2015 and 2022 snapshots."
    )
  )
```
